question: Can source-conditioned coefficient second moments retain task directions without separately optimizing68 variances from one short noisy archive?
single_change: Replace A42 per-task point ARD fitting by Gaussian source coefficient posterior second moments under the saved A37 outer-fold empirical-Bayes priors. No optimizer extension, hyperparameter search or source-mass change. This is a new candidate, not completion or promotion of A42.
source_posterior: In each outer fold, use only the30 training tasks and its saved A37 source-class priors. Precision-collapse same-candidate eta visits, project out each task intercept with the original Householder construction, and retain projected known measurement noise plus the existing0.02 shared-candidate discrepancy. For each of the two saved classes compute the Gaussian coefficient posterior mean m and covariance V. Class probabilities use its source projected marginal likelihood and the saved source pi. Set that task covariance diagonal to the class-posterior-weighted diag(V)+m^2. The new-target nonintercept coefficient mean remains zero; independent new signed coefficients inherit second moments only. All components use the existing0.25 intercept variance, common fold source intercept mean and0.02 discrepancy. Do not add another tail: the conditioning already starts from the saved proper A37 covariance with its tail.
prior: Keep30 equally weighted source-task moment covariances, excluding all tasks from both scored seeds. The two A37 covariances are fixed source regularizers; their own failed source validation remains recorded. Every new source posterior sees only the source task labels. No f/g conditioning, true support, source-quality weight or support pruning is introduced.
comparisons: U uses the original local atoms at1/4 each and the empirical source-moment distribution at total1/2. UG uses per-atom same-trace isotropic directions. P collapses the empirical covariance distribution while preserving the common mean and exact first two coefficient moments. Primary marginal next-observed-eta scores are U-I,U-UG,U-P. Retain U-A42_D and U-A37_L, early/late U-I and all five regimes. U-D is a comparison with the retained iteration-limited candidate, not with a converged solution.
analysis: Same80 source-validation paths, steps9-24, average policies within each latent task and four seed-pair blocks with20000 fixed paired bootstrap draws. Score no latent truth and no evaluation56-63. Do not tune from these results.
controls: Gaussian coefficient posterior against an independent linear regression calculation on unrelated small inputs; class posterior moments retain both posterior variance and squared posterior mean; coefficient means at new tasks remain zero. Reproduce original I and cached L/D scores. Every scored seed is excluded from both the saved A37 source hyperfit and source-task moment components. UG retains each covariance trace and P the exact empirical prior moments.
gate: Further source validation only if overall U-I,U-UG,U-P95 percent intervals are strictly positive and no regime U-I or U-UG interval is strictly negative. A pass does not permit KG or evaluation automatically. Failure retains all results and stops promotion; do not extend optimizers, alter source masses or select a support count.
limitations: This propagates uncertainty in source coefficients, not uncertainty in A37 empirical-Bayes hyperparameters or a posterior over exact supports. It uses the same short source archives and studied development cohort. Original I additionally uses a6144-call local source archive; U does not replace or equalize that archive. The experiment isolates the added cross-task prior. Conditional head sharing, early risk identification and decision alignment remain separate gaps.
